content:
Did you know....
You can earn ₹1000 ....
Just by reading a newsletter...
And answering 4 questions....

Well If someone had told me this earlier, I wouldn't have believe it too. But it is actually true. You see on monthly basis NISM publish their newsletter. Now it has a quiz option in which you are required to answer 4 questions. You will get the answer if you have read the whole newsletter....

Well hehe....
I have won once and even recieved the money....

But hey Nandini, what is the catch????
● Well you need to provide your details; if you won, your bank details will be asked (Note YOUR)
● You can win only twice in the preceding year from the date you made the submission for your details (well when you gave them the reply)
● Don't think that if you have given correct answers you will win... 
Even after giving correct answers there is a lottery system.

So what are you waiting for go and read the newsletter and try answering the questions....
(Aur agar Jeet jao to mujhe tag kardena post mein 😭😭😭😭)

comment: Interesting point is that such quizzes do more than reward participation—they create a habit of engaging with regulatory updates. For finance professionals, staying updated often matters more than the incentive itself.
